thread:
sam: heads-up from sales: big customer wants a per-route reserved pack for embeddings + monthly burst bucket, 12mo commit. can product/infra/legal scope?
anya: quick thought: ship as a "Reserved Route Pack" SKU, limit MVP to embeddings routes, console toggle and API flag.
mike: infra quick calc: 20 qps embeddings sustained -> ~13 GPU-hrs/day incremental. estimate infra cost ~$12k/mo. need scheduler token-bucket + soft reservation.
tara: product acceptance: 1) billing SKU + price bands, 2) console per-route qps UI, 3) API flag to opt-in routing, 4) fallback to best-effort with notice 5) runbook + pilot.
leo: legal: avoid hard guarantees. recommend "commercially reasonable efforts" + credits formula that caps exposure at ~25% monthly fee. include cancellation notice terms.
pat: sales wants three buckets to propose: Essentials (no reserve), Reserve (reserved qps, no SLA), Premier (reserved qps + burst credits + SLA + premium support).
anya: timeline to MVP if we scope tight (embeddings only, quantized models): ~6	6 weeks for product + infra + billing.
mike: infra work: 2 scheduler sprints + 1 for monitoring + token accounting. need policy for preemption and fallback routing.
tara: negotiation levers to give customer: cap monthly burst (e.g., 1M tokens), automatic fallback when exhausted, defined credit calculation, 30d cancellation.
leo: if they want private deployment variant, legal will add KMS/data residency clauses; pricing changes materially.
sam: owners: sam (sales liaison), anya (product spec & console), mike (cost model & infra plan), leo (contract draft). I'll schedule a twice-weekly sync.
legal-bot: created ticket PRD-6007: Reserved Route Pack (assignee: anya).
pat: thumbs-up on owners.
anya: will draft term sheet + rough pricing bands by Friday.
mike: will post cost sensitivity by Friday EOD.
leo: will have contract first pass by Monday.
sam: thanks all, sync invites coming.
